<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>

Write a funny song-style poem for kids about why you shouldn't eat a lot of sweets. The poem should have four sections, with each section marked with SECTION X.<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

SECTION 1: The Sugar Rush

I love to eat sweets, it's true,
Cupcakes and cookies, they're fun to chew.
But when I eat too many, oh what a sight,
I start to bounce off the walls, day and night!

My energy's high, but my tummy's not right,
I feel like a bouncy ball, spinning out of sight.
I run and I jump, and I dance with glee,
But then I crash down, and I'm as weak as can be!

SECTION 2: The Sugar Crash

My mom says, "Eat sweets in moderation, it's key,"
But I don't listen, and I eat them with glee.
I gobble them up, without a care,
But then I feel sick, and I don't know what to share.

My tummy hurts, and I feel so blue,
I wish I hadn't eaten, all those sweets anew.
I promise myself, I'll be more careful next time,
But the sweets are so tempting, and I just can't resist the crime!

SECTION 3: The Healthy Choice

My mom says, "Eat fruits and veggies, they're the way,"
To stay healthy and strong, every single day.
I try to eat more, of the good stuff, you see,
And I feel happy and healthy, just like me!

I eat my broccoli, and my carrots too,
And I feel like a superhero, with a healthy crew.
I run and I play, and I feel so free,
When I eat the good stuff, I'm as happy as can be!

SECTION 4: The Sweet Treat

But sometimes, just sometimes, I get a sweet treat,
A special occasion, or a birthday to eat.
I savor each bite, and I enjoy every chew,
And I remember, moderation is the key, it's true!

I eat my sweets, but not too many, you see,
And I feel happy and content, just like me.
I learn to balance, the sweet and the good,
And I feel happy and healthy, like I should!<|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|><|eot_id|>
